title: Washed clean
textBlocks: Jesus gets baptised in the Jordan River

Hello Bravehearts. 
In today’s true Bible story 
you will hear how Jesus got baptised
in the river 
that the Israelites are about to cross
to enter the promised land.

Jesus cousin, John the baptist was baptising people in the Jordan River.
John told the people to REPENT and be BAPTISED

Repent - means to say that you are sorry for your sins

- BEING BAPTISED - 
SHOWS OTHER PEOPLE THAT YOU BELONG TO GOD

Talk to Jesus
Dear Lord Jesus
Please forgive me for my sins
I want to follow You
You are my God
Amen
